items.text: Rock: How will Dahl's separate brands and units share order and financial data? — Integrating the Dahl businesses, which keep separate brands and units, may require manual reconciliation of order and financial data across units (inferred from the deal announcement; not confirmed).

Rock: Could post-deal integration timing be squeezed by the rights issue and EGM? — Kesko plans a €500-700m rights issue to refinance part of the bridge financing, with an EGM on 2026-10-30; terms not yet set.

Rock: Are warehouse rollouts and new ERP-style tooling creating integration gaps at the edges? — Manhattan Associates announced Kesko selected its ActiveWarehouse cloud solution across five distribution centres, with a new site in 2029-30. Whether adjacent workflows need extra integration work is unknown.

Lighthouse: Map manual reconciliation points in the Dahl integration — Hypothesis: a short mapping of where order and financial data are re-keyed between units could show whether automation is worth scoping.
Lighthouse: Pilot a reconciliation check on one approved sample — Hypothesis: a bounded pilot on one data flow could test whether a workflow fix is feasible before any wider scope.

rows: Map manual reconciliation points in the Dahl integration
Ask the integration lead for a list of 3 recurring data handoffs between Dahl and existing divisions, with consent to review them.
Proposed test: within an agreed period, the list is validated by the process owner and each handoff is labelled manual, semi-automated or automated.
Pilot a reconciliation check on one approved sample
Agree one approved, anonymised sample of order records with the process owner.
Proposed test: the pilot check matches the manual result on an agreed share of records, to be set with the owner before starting.

blocks.label: Captain's note (to the CEO)
blocks.text: Kesko's public signals point to a busy integration season, but nothing here shows what is happening inside the business. Before any proposal, we would want to hear from the people closest to the Dahl work and agree what is worth exploring. Happy to plan a route together if the timing and scope suit you.
Rocks are read from public evidence, not from inside the company. Chart is a conversation starter.
